question: The value of 16x ² + 4y </font&
solution:
**Formula used:**

To verify which option matches the expression.

**Calculations:**

1) Expand option (4x + 2y - 5z)²:

= (4x)² + (2y)² + (-5z)² + 2(4x)(2y) + 2(4x)(-5z) + 2(2y)(-5z)

= 16x² + 4y² + 25z² + 16xy - 40zx - 20yz

This does not match.

2) Expand option (4x - 2y - 5z)²:

= (4x)² + (-2y)² + (-5z)² + 2(4x)(-2y) + 2(4x)(-5z) + 2(-2y)(-5z)

= 16x² + 4y² + 25z² - 16xy - 40zx + 20yz

This matches!

3) Expand option (4x + 2y + 5z)²:

= (4x)² + (2y)² + (5z)² + 2(4x)(2y) + 2(4x)(5z) + 2(2y)(5z)

= 16x² + 4y² + 25z² + 16xy + 40zx + 20yz

This does not match.

4) Expand option (4x - 2y + 5z)²:

= (4x)² + (-2y)² + (5z)² + 2(4x)(-2y) + 2(4x)(5z) + 2(-2y)(5z)

= 16x² + 4y² + 25z² - 16xy + 40zx - 20yz

This does not match.

**∴ The expression 16x² + 4y² + 25z² - 16xy + 20yz - 40zx matches with option (4x - 2y - 5z)².**
